sections.title: What changed
items: Quiz Me works just as before: this release updates the built-in code every Snug app uses to talk to Snug to the version new apps are built with.
Customized your copy? You can skip this one — your version keeps working as it is.

sections.title: What's new
items: Vision, requirements, plan, lessons, and next tasks now install with the app as its own wiki.
A reconstructed build prompt — labeled retrospective — records how the quiz came to be.

sections.title: What's new
items: Pick any topic and take a five-question quiz generated on the spot.
Score history is saved, so you can watch yourself climb.
